asideNextText: Settling something simpler? Flip a Coin gives you a clean heads-or-tails decision.
asideText: Everything is generated locally in your browser with cryptographic randomness. Nothing is uploaded, stored, or tracked.

faq.a: It uses your browser's cryptographic random generator (crypto.getRandomValues) with rejection sampling and unbiased shuffling — the same quality of randomness used by security software, not the predictable Math.random().
All the standard polyhedral dice: d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d20, and d100 (percentile). Roll 1 to 10 at a time.
Yes — every roll is added to the history list with its dice and total, newest first, until you clear it.
faq.q: Can I see my previous rolls?

heroSubtitle: Fair virtual dice for games and classrooms — pick your die, roll up to ten at once, keep the history.
metaDescription: Roll up to 10 virtual dice online — d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d20 or d100 — with individual results, totals and roll history. Free, fair, cryptographically random.
title: Dice Roller — Roll Virtual Dice Online | ToolVerse
whenNotToUse: Virtual dice can't replace physical dice where a game or exam requires them — and a screen roll is easy to re-roll, so agree the rules with your group first.
It rolls standard dice only; exploding dice, advantage/disadvantage and other house rules need to be worked out from the individual results.
